tha-ap150:1.1: Phalakadāyaka.] Yānakāro pure āsiṃ dārukamme susikkhito / candanaphalakaṃ katvā adāsiṃ lokabandhuno. // //
tha-ap150:2.1: Pabhāsati idaṃ vyamhaṃ suvaṇṇassa sunimmitaṃ / hatthiyānaṃ assayānaṃ dibbayānaṃ upaṭṭhitaṃ. // //
tha-ap150:3.1: Pāsādā sivikā c' eva nibbattanti yadicchakaṃ / akkhobhaṃ ratanaṃ mayhaṃ phalakassa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap150:4.1: Ekanavute ito kappe phalakaṃ yaṃ ahaṃ dadiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phalakassa idaṃ phalaṃ // //
tha-ap150:5.1: Sattapaññāsakappamhi caturo Bhavanimmitā / sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā. // //
tha-ap150:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Phalakadāyako thero i. g. a-ti.
